history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY - flagged. The most likely referent of CSV 'Sati Temple, Lohardaga' is the Rani Sati Dadi Mandir at Gudri Bazar in Lohardaga town (place-listed at 23.431744, 84.680657), a small local shrine dedicated to Rani Sati (the venerated sati of Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan, widely worshipped in eastern India). Documentation is thin: only business/directory listings, no published history, founding date, or festival details. Alternative: a 'Sati Temple bansari' place entry also exists in Lohardaga district (~16 miles from Lohardaga) - unverified and could be the intended referent. Founding history, trust, and opening hours are not published anywhere found; verify locally before treating this entry as definitive.

name: Rani Sati Dadi Mandir
town_description: Lohardaga is the district headquarters town of Lohardaga district in Jharkhand. Local history links it to iron smelting ('Lohar' = ironmonger, 'dagga' = centre); it became a district on 17 May 1983 and is known for waterfalls and temples.
